tools.name: list_luigisbox_products
tools.description: List Luigi's Box products with a one-line description and the URL of each product page. Use this to answer what Luigi's Box offers before searching for details.

tools.name: read_luigisbox_page_as_markdown
tools.description: Fetch any page on luigisbox.com and return it as Markdown rather than HTML. Use it to read the current page, or any page listed in the site map at /llms.txt. Only luigisbox.com URLs are accepted.

url.description: A luigisbox.com URL. Defaults to the current page.
